metadata.description: Start and initialize a checkout-isolated CI Supabase test environment (RV-036: unique compose project/container names + dynamic port, derived from this checkout's path)
Tear down only this checkout's isolated CI Supabase test environment (never touches other checkouts' containers)

Run the reference-SQL security regression suite (30 cases) against the running Supabase stack. Local: run test-env first (checkout-isolated container, name resolved via docker/supabase-ci-identity.sh + state file). CI: the supabase action starts the stack with the compose default container name supabase-db. The script resolves the container name from SUPABASE_DB_CONTAINER or falls back accordingly.

options.command: VITE_SUPABASE_URL=$(../../docker/supabase-ci-url.sh) VITE_SUPABASE_KEY=$(grep 'SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:' ../../docker/docker-compose.ci.yml | head -1 | sed 's/.*SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:[[:space:]]*//') VITE_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=$(grep 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY:' ../../docker/docker-compose.ci.yml | head -1 | sed 's/.*SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY:[[:space:]]*//') vitest

metadata.description: Run Vitest tests against the CI Supabase test environment
